crossRefs.note: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for…
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his…
Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
translations.bsb: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
translations.kjv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
translations.asv: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.
